wholePhysicalScope: OpenStreetMap way 654074791 fixes the current footprint and its rotation. Public-domain printed illustration and the historic register document the rectangular rubble-limestone envelope.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the limestone volume, gabled shake roof, paired brick chimneys and shuttered sash rhythm.
limitations: The present map outline controls the geometry. Its long side is shorter than the approximate length listed in the 1965 historic survey.
Door and shutter profiles, chimney height, stone block pattern and surviving sill details are interpreted. Scope is the capitol exterior.
